branding.tagline: Monthly stableford, two Majors, a Euro trip, a knockout matchplay and a Birdie League. Best seven scores count — bring your A-game and your excuses.
branding.footer_blurb: Results, stats and banter from the Demo Golf Society.
branding.join_blurb: Fancy a game? New Demo welcome. Ask a member for the invite code.

handicap.note: Demo: one handicap per player, played off as-is on every course; only the admin changes it, by their own rules. No WHS, slope or course rating.

text: Top 7 scores for final total, count back decided on 8th score and so on. (Still level, then most appearances wins)
Any player scoring 40+ points will be cut a further shot
All winners will be cut 2 shots (Majors), (1 shot in monthly medal with 9 players or more)
Anyone failing to comply with any R&A rule will result in a two shot penalty.
In the event of a tie the result will be decided on a “count back” starting from Stroke Index one on the final day (All competitions)
At Majors, in the event of no second round, it will become a one round competition.
Matchplay: any player not turning up twice for their same match will be disqualified. Winner cut 1 shot.
Euro: winner gets cut 1 shot for the following Euro only.
